close_reason: Confirmed: role-swap pre-scan correctly handles A→B, B→A in same request; no change needed
description: mailbox.rs:536-557. Before the update loop, the handler pre-computes roles_vacated_this_request by scanning ALL updates in the request for patches that null out a role. This means the uniqueness check for any update that claims a role correctly accounts for other updates in the same request that vacate that role, regardless of iteration order. A contributor might suggest simplifying this by removing the pre-scan and only checking the pre-request state; that would break the case where one update vacates a role and another claims it in the same request. The pre-scan is necessary and correct.
title: Role-swap pre-scan in Mailbox/set update: correctly handles same-request A→B, B→A
